verdict.rationale: SSO/SAML is a fair question for a SaaS work-management platform like monday.com, but the evidence pack never documents SSO or SAML login for organizations. The nearby items cover other things: SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 infrastructure certifications, granular API scopes, per-agent identities, and an Active Directory integration for support tickets, so none of them count toward this story.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can secure organization access with SSO and SAML
